proposal.reason: Main functional change is CI execution logic: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds authenticated docker/login-action before image pull and replaces fixed pccl-tests pin with prepare-time branch/sha resolution (same-name branch with fallback to main), and .github/workflows/source-sanity.yml plus .github/workflows/pccl-daily-full.yml propagate that resolved revision/branch through checkouts, cache probe/publish keys, and runner-revision assertions. Supporting updates in .github/xtest/artifact_cache.py and .github/xtest/test_workflow_contract.py only relabel fixture metadata to match the new CI contract, so they remain within CI ownership rather than a separate module.
